G01.notes: Three goals connect design choices, root classifications and written evidence/limits. Writings remain ungraded; clicking alone is not mastery.

G02.notes: Two conditions have distinct purposes. Ten seeds are subsamples; two dates follow the same seeds. No repeated setup adds empty work. Repeatability requires independently prepared dishes.

G03.notes: Institutional sources support water/air/temperature requirements and emerged-root criterion. Exact counts/dose/time are clearly synthetic model choices, not published empirical parameters. No unresolved mechanism/procedure dispute remains for this virtual-only scope.

G04.notes: Model clock, enlarged roots, synthetic counts, matched conditions, omitted drying/mold/oxygen change and one-dish limitations appear beside observations and in handouts/reports.

G05.notes: Students choose dish conditions, place actual seed packets and measured water onto dishes, classify root emergence twice, check answers and explain the evidence. State and artwork respond to those actions.

G06.notes: Viewed start, damp setup, day 2/day 5, phone and tablet screenshots. Original shaded seeds, translucent dish rims, damp paper and emerging roots are plausible at the declared enlarged scale. Mouse/touch placement shares container geometry; scroll/resize/reload checked.

G07.notes: Concept choice order and root positions are shuffled once per attempt and persist on reload. Neither roots nor answers auto-enter student classifications. No assessment answer is supplied by a separate highlighted match display.

G08.notes: Reviewed English authored directions, labels, wrong-action messages, feedback, explanations and both handouts for short concrete wording. Germination/control/percentage/cumulative counts explained at use. Teacher/student comprehension remains pending; no reading-score certification is claimed.

G09.notes: Required prediction/design are explicitly labeled and gated in model and UI before setup. Initial plan is retained with actual before-observation timing; wrong predictions remain acceptable. No seed outcome precedes recorded planning.

G10.notes: Correct classification and concept answers say Correct! and explain the biology.
